closure_eligible_graph.rule: remove outgoing edges from OPEN_HANDLE_REGISTRY sources for solved self-composition

interpretation: The raw/queryable relation graph contains a dependency loop around the open hidden-state embedding.
DM 2.2 self-closure can still report zero child SCCs because its own policy excludes open handles from solved composition/promotion.
Therefore the loop is a blocker/diagnostic, not a contradiction and not a closure proof.
Breaking the loop requires an independently constructed witness or a lawful local-to-global construction; recursive reachability alone cannot select iota_H.
